task.spec:
Target: config/scripts/orchestration-wave-plan.mjs (the compiled step list and renderShell).
Change: the emitted script dispatches every wave back to back with no wait, so a real run starts wave-2 test workers while wave-1 implementations are still running. Emit one barrier step per non-final wave that waits for the previous wave to settle (orca orchestration check --wait --types "worker_done,escalation,question" --timeout-ms <n> --json), record it in the ledger as its own event so the schedule view shows where the run paused, and make the emitted script stop when a barrier returns a non-ok result instead of marching into the next wave.
Constraints: the existing argv for task-create / worker-start / gate-create must not change; run-create stays the only step above wave 0; barriers must not appear after the final wave; the stub-based orchestration-generated-script-check.mjs must still pass, so the stub has to answer the new command.
Write set: config/scripts/orchestration-wave-plan.mjs, config/scripts/orchestration-generated-script-check.mjs (stub branch only, if the new argv needs an answer).
Acceptance: node config/scripts/orchestration-generated-script-check.mjs exits 0, and the script it generates contains exactly one orchestration check --wait per non-final wave and none after the last wave.
